title: Wideband Receive Array
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Transmitters and Receivers/Wideband_Receive_Array.md
text: 放大输入信号，并引入非线性失真和附加噪声，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Noise figure (dB)} 指定噪声系数；{Enable signal enabling input} 指定使能信号输入、{Add noise to input signal} 指定向输入信号添加噪声、{Input noise temperature (K)} 指定输入噪声温度、{Sample rate (Hz)} 指定采样率 1e6、{Inherit sample rate} 指定从上游模块继承采样率、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted、{Noise method} 指定噪声方法 None、{Noise factor} 指定噪声因子、{Reference temperature (K)} 指定参考温度、{Gain method} 指定增益方法 Linear、{Gain (dB)} 指定线性接收机增益、{Output IP3 (dBm)} 输出 IP3、{Lookup table} 查找表、{Phased offset (degrees)} 指定相位偏移、{Source of seed for random number generator} 指定随机数生成器的种子来源、{Seed for random number generator} 指定随机数生成器的种子，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 接收信号 complex-valued vector | complex-valued matrix

ports.name: EN
ports.summary: 使能信号 real-valued vector (default) | real-valued matrix | logical-valued vector | logical-valued matrix

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 放大后的信号 complex-valued vector | complex-valued matrix

params.name: Enable signal enabling input
params.values: 使能信号输入 false 0 (default) | true 1

params.name: Add noise to input signal
params.values: 向输入信号添加噪声 off (default) | on

params.name: Input noise temperature (K)
params.values: 输入噪声温度 290 (default) | positive scalar | length- N vector of positive values

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: 从上游模块继承采样率 on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation

params.name: Noise method
params.values: 噪声方法 None | Noise figure | Noise factor | Noise temperature

params.name: Noise figure (dB)
params.values: 噪声系数 3 (default) | real scalar | length- N vector or real values

params.name: Noise factor
params.values: 噪声因子 2 (default) | positive scalar | length- N vector of positive values

params.name: Reference temperature (K)
params.values: 参考温度 290 (default) | positive scalar | length- N vector of positive values

params.name: Gain method
params.values: 增益方法 Linear (default) | Cubic polynomial | Lookup table

params.name: Gain (dB)
params.values: 线性接收机增益 20 (default) | real scalar | length- N vector of real values

params.name: Output IP3 (dBm)
params.values: 输出 IP3 Inf (default) | scalar | length- N vector of real values

params.name: Lookup table
params.values: 查找表 [-25, 5, -1; -10, 20, -2; 0, 27, 5; 5, 28, 12] (default) | M -by- N real-valued matrix | M -by- N real-valued matrix

params.name: Phased offset (degrees)
params.values: 相位偏移 0 (default) | scalar | length- N vector of real values

params.name: Source of seed for random number generator
params.values: 随机数生成器的种子来源 Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Seed for random number generator
params.values: 随机数生成器的种子 0 (default) | positive integer
